parent_id.description: Reply to another comment of the same task; empty means a root comment.

ParentID — optional subtask (operation) link: task of the given parent.
When set, process_id must point to the parent's process; dates and
owner may be omitted and are inherited from the parent by the service.

type.description: Dependency type: fs | ss | ff | sf.

dependencies.description:
Scheduling links between the tasks of the process (the successor
task_id depends on depends_on_task_id with the given type).

order.description: Order of the process within its project (ascending display order).

comments_count.description: Number of active comments on the task (for the badge on the diagram).

order.description:
Order of the task within its parent group (ascending display order):
top-level tasks sort within the process, subtasks within the parent.

parent_id.description: ParentID — subtask (operation) link; NULL for top-level tasks.

subtasks.description:
Subtasks (operations) attached to this task, in display order.
Present only on top-level tasks; subtasks cannot have subtasks.

preset.description: Preset — the preset TAG (dp/rp/vp/worker/custom), never its display name.

resource.description: Resource — the resource code from the engine dictionary.

scope.description:
Scope — the canonical scope expression, or "none" when the preset holds
no right for the cell (an empty string would read as a granted right).

order.description: Order of the process within its project (ascending display order).

Order of the task within its parent group (ascending display order):
top-level tasks sort within the process, subtasks within the parent.

parent_id.description: ParentID — subtask (operation) link; NULL for top-level tasks.

operations.description:
Operations (subtasks) of the task — created as subtasks (parent_id)
with the task's dates. Status is always not_started; resources are not
bound to subtasks.

owner_id.description:
ProcessID is intentionally absent: a task never changes its process.
ParentID is absent too: the parent is fixed at creation.

name.description: Full name "Last First Middle" (pre-composed, for display).

user_id.description:
UserID is set only in batch responses (GET /user/days), where one worker's
ranges are nested among several — hence omitempty.
